data_generator: src.acceleration_boosting.prepare_dataset; synthetic 768 rows/10 features/5 informative/flip_y .08/class_sep .8, stratified 256/256/256; bundled breast_cancer stratified60/20/20
scan_contrasts: Paired train maximum-scan score rs1-rs0 and rs10-rs0, two datasets, Student-t95 and Bonferroni family4 intervals. Predict positive only for rs10; rs1 has no sign prediction.
fixed_boundary_contrasts: Same four paired contrasts for fixed-boundary train gain; prespecified diagnostic with no sign prediction; separate family4 Bonferroni intervals.
natural_gate: Per dataset x rs (six groups): mean fixed-boundary train gain lower adjustedCI>0, mean train drop loss[512]-loss[575] lower adjustedCI>.01, and>=10/12 positive seed gains. Bonferroni family12 for six gain and six drop scalar intervals. This fixed-window operational gate does not identify annealing causality.
